notes: Own-harness run through securevibes-agent with ScanEval Observer hooks enabled when the checkout supports them.
The model route is openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol through pi. Authenticate the OpenAI Codex provider in pi before running.
The pi route may not report token usage, cost, or independently served model identity. ScanEval records those fields as unavailable rather than inventing values.
llm_max_files bounds how many files reach the model. Keep the input list small until the pilot labels have human approval.
The harness root uses a leading ~ so it expands for the operator. Point it at the securevibes-agent checkout you intend to evaluate.
Content-mode traces and per-call pi sessions stay local because they can contain source code and previously unknown findings. This configuration is not a publishable comparison by itself.
